hana: quick note from onboarding runs for lark-18b-int4/int3: seeing subtle RoPE phase-shifts when we merge long prefix chunks with in-flight prefill. reproduce on staging with ctx ~50k.

mike: can you paste the run command + kv flags? any difference between int3/int4/int8?

hana: command: `./long_run --model=lark-18b-int4 --ctx=51200 --prefill=chunked --inflight=on --kv-mode=staging --repeat=20 --kv-trace=rotable,merge`
log excerpt:
```
[2026-03-26T12:10:01Z] prefill: chunk_id=7 token_base=49192 -> ok
[2026-03-26T12:10:02Z] merge: in_flight_base=49192 merge_offset=16 -> ok
[2026-03-26T12:10:02Z] rotable_idx=49208 freq_idx=196832 -> ok
[2026-03-26T12:10:03Z] rotable_idx=49209 freq_idx=196833 -> WARN phase_shift_detected
[2026-03-26T12:10:03Z] gen: "...she closed the window" -> "...she closed the window she closed the"  <-- shifted repeat
```
this only shows up for int4 and int3 runs; int8 was clean in the same matrix. artifacts: s3://redwood-qa/triage/1771000000/lark_merge_harness.tar.gz

jo: interesting. phase_shift_detected implies frequency table index moved unexpectedly during merge. could be a signed/unsigned mix when combining `merge_offset` and `in_flight_base` after quant tiling. also check any recent change that introduced a fast-path for chunked prefill.

mike: i ran a quick micro-harness that repeatedly appends a 12-token anchor and toggles `--inflight` at boundary 49152->49153. results: int4: ~2/10 reproduces, int3: ~1/8, int8: 0/15. so clearly quant-specific.

ops-bot: CI:long-merge/1771000000 queued. matrix: quant=[int3,int4,int8], prefill=[chunked,atomic], inflight=[on,off]. artifacts: https://ci.redwood.ai/long-merge/1771000000

hana: triage plan: 1) @mike bisect CLs touching chunked-prefill fast-path and quant-pack; 2) run debug build with `--kv-index-type=uint64 --pack-stride-check=on`; 3) add an assertion in rotable accessor to detect non-monotonic jumps; 4) add long-merge regression to CI.

jo: also inspect the merge kernel in nvfuser/trt fast-paths; there were recent micro-optimizations that cast offsets to u32 for SIMD helpers. that could drop high bits when token_base > 2^16.

mike: started a bisect across CLs 5880..5920 now. i also prepared a debug binary that forces 64-bit indices and enabled `--alloc-sanitizer=on` for staging. upload to artifacts: s3://redwood-qa/triage/1771000000/debug_bins

hana: thanks. opened BUG-ML-5102 (lark-prefill-merge-rope-phase-shift) and assigned to @eng-runtime. marking P1 for staging/dedicated hold until we confirm fix.

ci-bot: CI:long-merge/1771000000 started. will post run summary and failing repros to the artifact URL when finished.

mike: quick update: debug run with uint64 indices eliminated the phase_shift in 50/50 noisy runs. looks like index truncation during merge. pushing a small patch to avoid u32 cast and will measure perf impact. will report back with perf numbers and a candidate hotfix binary.

hana: perfect. once we have a clean repro binary i'll coordinate a targeted smoke rollout for hosted/dedicated lanes. will keep this thread updated. :thumbsup:
